description: Canonical inputs for differential testing of the pure-Elixir lid.176 implementation against the fastText reference.
notes: Each entry pairs a short natural-language phrase with the language code it is expected to resolve to.
The expected_label column is informational only — fastText is the source of truth in the generated fixture file.
Edits should preserve the existing strings and only ever extend the list, so previously-generated golden fixtures remain valid.
